name: docker
title: Production Dockerfile (bun)
description: Multi-stage Dockerfile for a vite-built TanStack Start app on Bun, plus serve.ts (serves dist/client statics in front of dist/server/server.js) and .dockerignore. Requires bun.lock. Healthcheck uses /api/health from @john/health.

files.content:
# syntax=docker/dockerfile:1
# Production image for a TanStack Start app built with `vite build` and run on Bun.

FROM oven/bun:1 AS build
WORKDIR /app
COPY package.json bun.lock ./
RUN bun install --frozen-lockfile
COPY . .
RUN bun run build

FROM oven/bun:1 AS deps
WORKDIR /app
COPY package.json bun.lock ./
RUN bun install --frozen-lockfile --production

FROM oven/bun:1-slim
WORKDIR /app
ENV NODE_ENV=production PORT=3000
COPY --from=deps /app/node_modules ./node_modules
COPY --from=build /app/dist ./dist
COPY package.json serve.ts ./
USER bun
EXPOSE 3000
# Liveness only (no DB I/O). /api/health comes from @john/health.
HEALTHCHECK --interval=30s --timeout=5s --start-period=10s \
  CMD ["bun", "-e", "const r = await fetch(`http://localhost:${process.env.PORT}/api/health`); process.exit(r.ok ? 0 : 1)"]
CMD ["bun", "run", "serve.ts"]
